claims: Austin Wells was born in Scottsdale, Arizona.
Austin Wells grew up in Las Vegas, Nevada.
Austin Wells' mother is Michelle Fernandez.
Michelle Fernandez is of Dominican descent.
Michelle Fernandez's Dominican descent qualifies Austin Wells to represent the Dominican Republic under WBC rules.
Austin Wells played for Team Dominican Republic in the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Austin Wells hit a walk-off home run to advance Team Dominican Republic to the semifinals in the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Austin Wells is a catcher for the New York Yankees.
Austin Wells stated it was an "unbelievable honor" to represent the Dominican Republic
